summary: Russian forces launched multiple Shahed drone strikes on Kyiv and surrounding areas on September 23, 2026, targeting the capital's infrastructure including a fuel station and postal terminal. Ukrainian Defense Forces reported destroying over 350,000 Russian drones since the start of the year and inflicted significant casualties on FSB officers in the Kherson region. Operation Valdi on the Liman direction has halted Russian attempts to encircle the Sloviansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration, though enemy forces have been redirected southward.
key_points: AFU strike on Kherson region killed 15 FSB officers and wounded approximately 30, with fire centers confirmed in Strelkovoye via satellite imagery on the night of September 19 (Source: @UkraineNow/84236).
Multiple Shahed drone attacks struck Kyiv and suburbs including Vyshneve, Hostomel, Vasylkiv, and a Nova Poshta terminal on September 23, 2026 (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75537).

Operation Valdi on the Liman direction stopped Russian attempts to encircle the Sloviansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration; enemy redirected forces to Mykolaivka, a key point before Sloviansk (Source: @UkraineNow/84238).
AFU destroyed over 350,000 Russian drones since the start of the year: 220,000 aircraft-type UAVs, 100,000 helicopter-type drones, and 31,000 Shaheds (Source: @UkraineNow/84248).
Russian strikes set fire to the Ukrnafta fuel station in Kyiv for the second time in recent weeks, killing one worker in hospital (Source: @eRadarrua/115935).
Interpipe Steel pipe-rolling plant halted production following a strike by the Russian Armed Forces (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33432).

Russian forces carried out group strikes on military-industrial enterprises, fuel-energy complex facilities, and logistics centers, according to the Russian Ministry of Defense (Source: @tass_agency/396880).

A German company Kromberg & Schubert plant in Zhytomyr caught fire following a Russian attack; the facility is the largest supplier of electrical systems and wiring for the automotive industry (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33440).

sections.executive_summary: On September 23, 2026, Russian forces launched multiple Shahed drone strikes against Kyiv and its suburbs, targeting civilian infrastructure including a fuel station and postal terminal. Ukrainian Defense Forces reported destroying over 350,000 Russian drones since the start of the year and inflicted heavy casualties on FSB personnel in the Kherson region. Operation Valdi on the Liman direction has successfully halted Russian attempts to encircle the Sloviansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration, though the enemy has redirected forces southward to Mykolaivka.
ukraine: Ukrainian Defense Forces destroyed over 350,000 Russian drones since the start of 2026, comprising 220,000 aircraft-type UAVs, 100,000 helicopter-type drones, and 31,000 Shahed attack drones, according to the Ministry of Defense (Source: @UkraineNow/84248).

Operation Valdi on the Liman direction stopped Russian attempts to encircle the Sloviansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration, though the enemy redirected forces south to Mykolaivka, a key point before Sloviansk; the situation is described as complex but controlled (Source: @UkraineNow/84238).

AFU struck the Kherson region, killing 15 FSB officers and wounding approximately 30; the monitoring group Crimean Wind confirmed fire centers in Strelkovoye via satellite imagery on the night of September 19 (Source: @UkraineNow/84236).
Defense Forces of Ukraine returned control of positions near Zakhidne, as confirmed by the DeepState map update (Source: @DeepStateUA/23849).

Ukraine received $841 million for pensions under Canadian guarantees, financed through the World Bank PEACE in Ukraine project, according to Prime Minister Serhiy Koretskyi (Source: @UkraineNow/84235).
AFU officer Onistrat displayed a bus fitted with metal bars used to transport mobilized troops under armed guard to prevent escape en route to training units (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33430).
Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk stated that Ukrainian casualties have reached approximately 27,000 killed and wounded per month, attributing the rise to new factors (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33439).
russia: Russian forces carried out group strikes on military-industrial enterprises, fuel-energy complex facilities, and logistics centers in Ukraine, as claimed by the Russian Ministry of Defense (Source: @tass_agency/396880).

Russian strikes hit the Ukrnafta fuel station in Kyiv for the second time in recent weeks; one worker died in hospital after being wounded, while safety protocols and shelter protocols prevented further casualties among staff (Source: @eRadarrua/115935).
Russian Armed Forces struck the Interpipe Steel pipe-rolling plant, forcing it to halt production (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33432).

A Russian attack set fire to a Kromberg & Schubert plant in Zhytomyr, the largest German supplier of electrical systems, cables, and complex wiring for the automotive industry (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33440).
Russian forces struck Nova Poshta warehouses in Usatovo near Odessa, causing fires (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33420).
US Secretary of State Rubio stated that Ukraine is attacking US-linked oil tankers and emphasized that this cannot continue (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33435).
DPR leader Denis Pushilin stated that a large number of negotiators on Ukraine will introduce more disagreements, suggesting Russia's diplomatic posture remains active (Source: @tass_agency/396866).
eastern_front: Operation Valdi on the Liman direction successfully stopped Russian attempts to encircle the Sloviansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration, according to DeepState co-founder Roman Pohorilyi (Source: @UkraineNow/84238).
Russian forces redirected their forces southward to Mykolaivka, described as a key point before Sloviansk; the situation there is complex but controlled (Source: @UkraineNow/84238).
DeepState map updated to show Ukrainian Defense Forces returning control of positions near Zakhidne in the eastern area (Source: @DeepStateUA/23849).
northern_front: Reconnaissance drones were detected in the north of Chernihiv region near Ripki, moving in a southwesterly direction (Source: @kpszsu/79633).
New drone activity was detected in the north of Chernihiv region (Source: @eRadarrua/115903).
Two drones were detected near Slavutich in the Chernobyl zone, and two more from Poltavshchyna following a standard route past Cherkashchyna toward Kyivshchyna (Source: @eRadarrua/115886).
Two drones were detected at Hlevakha, apparently circling in the suburbs of the capital (Source: @eRadarrua/115885).
Drones were tracked from Rzhyshchev toward Hrebinky, the closest point to the capital, flying at approximately 6 kilometers altitude (Source: @eRadarrua/115859).
southern_front: AFU strike on the Kherson region killed 15 FSB officers and wounded approximately 30 personnel; fire centers in Strelkovoye were confirmed by satellite imagery on the night of September 19 (Source: @UkraineNow/84236).
Nova Poshta warehouses caught fire in Usatovo, near Odessa, following Russian strikes (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33420).

sections.threat_assessment: The sustained Shahed drone campaign against Kyiv on September 23, 2026, combined with reconnaissance drone activity from multiple directions, indicates Russia maintains persistent strike capability against the Ukrainian capital despite extensive Ukrainian air defense intercepts. The strike on the Ukrnafta fuel station for the second time in recent weeks demonstrates Russian targeting of critical energy infrastructure. The confirmed FSB casualties in Kherson suggest Ukrainian forces are increasingly striking Russian security personnel in the southern theater. The redirection of Russian forces from the Liman direction to Mykolaivka indicates a strategic recalibration aimed at the Sloviansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration.
sections.regional_response: EU ambassadors agreed for the first time to extend sanctions against Russia for three years, while EU Commission President von der Leyen urged Ukraine to accelerate anti-shadow economy legislation and align with EU standards, linking reform progress to additional financial support. Ukraine is requesting partners cover an additional €26 billion budget shortfall and expedite a €90 billion EU loan. Hungary declined to participate in the Carpathian Eight initiative and blocked the construction of a petroleum storage facility for Ukraine on its territory. Polish Prime Minister Tusk highlighted the scale of Ukrainian casualties at approximately 27,000 per month.
sections.intelligence_notes: The pattern of reconnaissance drones approaching Kyiv from multiple axes—north via Chernihiv and Slavutich, west via Zhytomyr and Korosten, and southwest via Rzhyshchev and Hrebinky—suggests a coordinated multi-axis surveillance operation preceding potential strike missions. Drones were tracked at approximately 6 kilometers altitude on routes toward the capital. The Russian Ministry of Defense's claim of group strikes on military-industrial and energy facilities indicates a continued strategy of targeting Ukraine's defense industrial base. Mexican drug cartels are reportedly recruiting Ukrainian veterans to train drone operators, highlighting the proliferation of war-derived expertise beyond the conflict zone.
